description: This source file defines an enum `MenuItemHighlightColors` which provides methods to determine highlight colors for menu items in a macOS app, with a nested `Palette` struct to hold primary and secondary colors.

classes.name: MenuItemHighlightColors
classes.description: An enum providing static methods to determine highlight colors for menu items, including a nested `Palette` struct to hold related colors.

classes.name: Palette
classes.description: A struct within `MenuItemHighlightColors` that holds primary and secondary `Color` values for highlighting.

methods.name: primary(_ highlighted: Bool) -> Color
methods.description: Returns the primary highlight color based on whether the item is highlighted.

methods.name: secondary(_ highlighted: Bool) -> Color
methods.description: Returns the secondary highlight color with opacity adjustment based on whether the item is highlighted.

methods.name: palette(_ highlighted: Bool) -> Palette
methods.description: Returns a `Palette` instance with primary and secondary colors configured according to the highlighted state.
